model_independence.reference_method: For every present transformed grayscale threshold, independently flood-fill connected pixel sets; derive canonical representatives and strict-containing parents by set relations; compare exact Fraction variation scores.

manual_source_review: Read new RTL, all-port example, inherited production max-tree RTL, full TB, independent reference, preparation/gate/guards/runner/validator, mathematical contract, architecture/cost/dependency/license documents, and fixed plan metadata.

Dense component contract, bright/dark transform, canonical seed and parent rules, inclusive Delta ancestry, exact variation fractions, independent adjacent-gray pair comparisons, parent-wins equality, root exclusion, inclusive area limits, and strict n*Q<P*area filter agree at source level.
Nine-step unsigned 9x9 multiplication retains eighteen-bit exact products for the finite parameter domain; area 256 is represented without a sentinel or saturation.

Pair cancellation only clears selected bits and does not suppress subsequent comparisons. Full node-bank overwrite occurs before analysis. Output restoration for dark mode and held-field control agree with the contract.
First-transfer config/tag capture, drain-and-zero malformed/error response, synchronous reset gating, and legal/invalid generate branches were inspected.

TB scores every stored output field, input transfers, blocked future offers, held output tuples, work/latency receipts, and distinct fixed reset predicates. Reset probe output prefixes are structurally checked without adding numerical probe solver calls.
Named compile rejects require the fixed missing invalid-parameter module diagnostic; no reject or compile was executed.

process_and_tool_closure.job_helper: Raw-identical existing process_tree helper: suspended CreateProcess, kill-on-close Job assignment before ResumeThread, hidden window, hard twenty-second process-tree deadline and bounded failure drain.
process_and_tool_closure.preparation_gate: External root approval binds exact author seal/plan/child argv, max_invocations=1, hard_seconds=20, no automatic retry, and at least two frozen static-review anchors. Exact unprepared inventory and exclusive preparation output are required.
process_and_tool_closure.runner_gate: External root approval binds source seal, author seal, test plan and exact children with at least two review anchors. Exact source/copied inventory, tools/runtime closure, and artifacts are guarded around every child.
process_and_tool_closure.raw_and_failure_policy: Persist raw child streams before parsing, stop on first failure, preserve receipts/partial outputs/source archive, record later child slots NOT_RUN, and provide no automatic retry or cleanup.
process_and_tool_closure.artifact_policy: Five fixed VVP images are required before simulation; emitted VPI references are checked against the pinned six-module set.
process_and_tool_closure.observation_limit: File hashes and authored execution envelopes were reviewed. Dynamic loader behavior and actual tool/HDL behavior were not observed.

limitations: This source-only review is not an execution approval and does not establish compiler, simulation, timing, synthesis, PPA, or hardware correctness.
No preparation/reference/fixtures/guards/runner/compiler/simulation or HDL was run. Planned certificates and reset-target observations remain unexecuted obligations.
Any future preparation or HDL run still requires the root-controlled approval gates and independent frozen reviews specified in the source plans.
